Supply Chain Analyst / Supply Chain Specialist (F&B)Role Description

We are seeking organized, analytical, and business-oriented professionals for the positions of Supply Chain Analyst and Supply Chain Specialist (F&B). These roles focus on coordinating supply chain activities, optimizing procurement and inventory processes, and ensuring the efficient movement of food and beverage products throughout the supply network.

Responsibilities include analyzing supply chain performance, monitoring inventory levels, coordinating procurement activities, evaluating supplier performance, and supporting demand and supply planning. Professionals will work closely with suppliers, procurement teams, warehouse operations, logistics providers, and internal departments to maintain product availability and ensure efficient distribution.

The roles also involve tracking orders and deliveries, reviewing stock movements, identifying supply chain inefficiencies, preparing operational reports, and supporting cost-control initiatives. Supply Chain Analysts may additionally conduct data analysis, forecast demand, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and recommend process improvements. Supply Chain Specialists will focus on supplier coordination, purchasing activities, inventory management, logistics arrangements, and operational execution within the food and beverage industry.
Understanding of supply chain management, procurement, and logistics operations.
Knowledge of inventory control, demand planning, and stock management.
Familiarity with supplier coordination and purchasing processes.
Understanding of food and beverage distribution and supply chain requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and operational reporting tools.
Ability to analyze supply chain data and identify improvement opportunities.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Good communication and supplier relationship management skills.
Attention to detail and ability to coordinate multiple operational activities.
Adaptability and a strong commitment to operational efficiency.
